name: The Man in the Moon
source:
It is the time, where we tried to send people to the moon.

Some people like the idea, and some do not.

You are Chase Vowles, a scientist, who is working at the NASA. You are one of the people who watch the rocket and check if everything is working correctly.

You often see, how anarchists try to sabotage the rocket...And he always sees, how they fail. Because of his job, he doesn't have time for his family, which often leads to fatal situations. And while he's arguing with his wife, some guys are planning something terrible...

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/the-man-in-the-moon/33964/]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
那是人类尝试把人送上月球的时代。

有人喜欢这个想法，也有人不喜欢。

你是NASA的科学家蔡斯·沃尔斯，负责观察火箭，确认一切正常运行。

你经常看到无政府主义者试图破坏火箭……也总能看到他们失败。由于工作繁忙，你没有时间陪伴家人，常常因此酿成致命局面。当你与妻子争吵时，一群人正在策划可怕的阴谋……

[来源：[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/the-man-in-the-moon/33964/]GameJolt[/url]]
